sonnet.problem: The blank asks for the exact word "quenched", a hard word. The baker has not seen this wording and can only get it by eliminating "lit" and "felt". It asks for the wording of a line, not for meaning the baker can reason out.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

sonnet.problem: The statement says "The sword is told to strike in only one direction." Verse 16 never says who is being spoken to. It gives the commands "Slash to the right; set your blade to the left" without naming the sword as the one addressed.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

sonnet.problem: "No punchline after that" is Papa Dorin commenting on how he is telling the passage. He is not supposed to do that.
sonnet.rule: He talks as "I" and never comments on how he tells the passage.
